core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sabreen corresponds to the Arabic form صَابِرِين (Arabic root ص ب ر (ṣ-b-r); صَابِرِين (Ṣābirīn)). Its core sense is sabreen; patient ones (plural).
